remarks: This beautifully renovated 10th-floor, 1-bed/1-bath condo offers an open layout enhanced with custom cabinetry, wood plank floors, stainless steel appliances, crown molding, and stunning views. The Biltmore is a short 12-minute walk to the Stamford Train Station (Metro-North) and provides a convenient shuttle service. Located right in the heart of downtown, this building offers a range of amenities including a 24-hour concierge, a fully renovated gym, a 4th-floor terrace, same-day dry cleaning, and on-site parking available through Propark for $115/month. This is a fantastic opportunity to own a spacious move-in ready 1-bed condo in downtown Stamford! The current tenant lease runs until 9/30/24. New hot water heater 2023, new HVAC system 2023 & new microwave 2024.
